description: This Java class defines a Spring configuration component named OpenmrsPropertyConfig. It provides a PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer bean that initializes configuration properties using OpenmrsUtil.getApplicationDataDirectory(), setting properties and resource locations for application properties files used by OpenMRS.

classes.name: OpenmrsPropertyConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up property placeholders for OpenMRS application, ensuring application data directory properties are correctly loaded at runtime.

methods.name: propertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer
methods.description: Defines a singleton bean that creates and configures a PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer with properties and resource locations based on application data directory.
